```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w002.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Recompute SCI
departures = df['StartBorough'].value_counts()
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']]['StartBorough'].value_counts()
arrivals = df['EndBorough'].value_counts()
total_arrivals = arrivals.sum()
arrival_share = arrivals / total_arrivals

all_boroughs = sorted(set(departures.index) | set(arrivals.index))
departures = departures.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
self_contained = self_contained.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrivals = arrivals.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrival_share = arrival_share.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
expected_self_contained = departures * arrival_share
sci = self_contained / expected_self_contained

# Build adjacency dict
adj_dict = {b: set() for b in all_boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    n = row['neighbor']
    if b in adj_dict and n in adj_dict:
        adj_dict[b].add(n)
        adj_dict[n].add(b)

n = len(all_boroughs)
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(all_boroughs)}

# Build row-standardized weights matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for b in all_boroughs:
    i = borough_to_idx[b]
    neighbors = list(adj_dict[b])
    deg = len(neighbors)
    if deg > 0:
        for nb in neighbors:
            j = borough_to_idx[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg

print("Weights matrix W:")
print(pd.DataFrame(W, index=all_boroughs, columns=all_boroughs))

# Compute z-scores (population std)
x = sci.values
z = (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=0)
print("\nZ-scores:")
for b, zi in zip(all_boroughs, z):
    print(f"{b}: {zi:.4f}")

# Compute spatial lag
lag = W @ z
print("\nSpatial lag:")
for b, li in zip(all_boroughs, lag):
    print(f"{b}: {li:.4f}")

# Compute local Moran's I
local_I = z * lag
print("\nLocal Moran's I:")
for b, ii in zip(all_boroughs, local_I):
    print(f"{b}: {ii:.4f}")

# Determine quadrants
print("\nQuadrants (z, lag):")
for b, zi, li in zip(all_boroughs, z, lag):
    quad = "HH" if zi > 0 and li > 0 else ("LL" if zi < 0 and li < 0 else ("HL" if zi > 0 and li < 0 else "LH"))
    print(f"{b}: z={zi:.4f}, lag={li:.4f} -> {quad}")
```

```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/cyclehire_w002.csv'
ADJACENCY_PATH = 'chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv'

df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Recompute SCI
departures = df['StartBorough'].value_counts()
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']]['StartBorough'].value_counts()
arrivals = df['EndBorough'].value_counts()
total_arrivals = arrivals.sum()
arrival_share = arrivals / total_arrivals

all_boroughs = sorted(set(departures.index) | set(arrivals.index))
departures = departures.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
self_contained = self_contained.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrivals = arrivals.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
arrival_share = arrival_share.reindex(all_boroughs, fill_value=0)
expected_self_contained = departures * arrival_share
sci = self_contained / expected_self_contained

# Build adjacency dict
adj_dict = {b: set() for b in all_boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    n = row['neighbor']
    if b in adj_dict and n in adj_dict:
        adj_dict[b].add(n)
        adj_dict[n].add(b)

n = len(all_boroughs)
borough_to_idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(all_boroughs)}

# Build row-standardized weights matrix
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for b in all_boroughs:
    i = borough_to_idx[b]
    neighbors = list(adj_dict[b])
    deg = len(neighbors)
    if deg > 0:
        for nb in neighbors:
            j = borough_to_idx[nb]
            W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg

# z-scores
x = sci.values
z = (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=0)

# Observed local I
lag = W @ z
local_I_obs = z * lag

# Conditional permutation test: 500 shuffles
n_perm = 500
np.random.seed(42)

p_values = np.ones(n)
for i in range(n):
    z_i = z[i]
    w_row = W[i, :].copy()
    observed_I = local_I_obs[i]
    
    permuted_I = np.zeros(n_perm)
    other_indices = [j for j in range(n) if j != i]
    z_others = z[other_indices]
    
    for p in range(n_perm):
        z_shuffled = z.copy()
        np.random.shuffle(z_others)
        z_shuffled[other_indices] = z_others
        lag_perm = w_row @ z_shuffled
        permuted_I[p] = z_i * lag_perm
    
    if observed_I > 0:
        p_val = np.mean(permuted_I >= observed_I)
    elif observed_I < 0:
        p_val = np.mean(permuted_I <= observed_I)
    else:
        p_val = 1.0
    
    p_values[i] = p_val

# Determine quadrants
results = []
for i, b in enumerate(all_boroughs):
    zi = z[i]
    li = lag[i]
    ii = local_I_obs[i]
    p = p_values[i]
    
    if zi > 0 and li > 0:
        quad = "HH"
    elif zi < 0 and li < 0:
        quad = "LL"
    elif zi > 0 and li < 0:
        quad = "HL"
    else:
        quad = "LH"
    
    results.append({
        'Borough': b,
        'SCI': sci[b],
        'Z': zi,
        'Lag': li,
        'Local_I': ii,
        'Quadrant': quad,
        'P_value': p,
        'Significant_05': p < 0.05
    })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(results_df.to_string())
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("Significant HH (p < 0.05):")
print(results_df[(results_df['Quadrant'] == 'HH') & (results_df['Significant_05'])].to_string())
print("\nSignificant LL (p < 0.05):")
print(results_df[(results_df['Quadrant'] == 'LL') & (results_df['Significant_05'])].to_string())
```
